description: Native (mobile) session contract for /v1/auth/native/*. No cookies, no CSRF: the refresh token travels in JSON and must be kept in secure storage. Every successful refresh rotates it; the previous value is single-use and presenting it again more than 10 s after rotation revokes the whole session (within 10 s it is only rejected). Logout is possession-based: the refresh token in the body suffices. Sign-in is Google-only until launch (RCAB-E8.S15): GET /v1/auth/config lists the enabled methods; the Firebase phone exchange answers 403 auth_method_disabled while `phone` is not among them. `user.phone_e164` is null for Google-registered accounts and `user.email` null for phone-only ones. Asserted by apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.controller.spec.ts and test/integration/auth.int.spec.ts.

config.note: google.clientId is the first GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS entry, or null when the server has none (Google sign-in then answers 503 google_not_configured). Render only the listed methods.

body.id_token: <google-id-token for the web OAuth client id (Android: serverClientId)>

google.semantics: Logs in the account with this google_sub, otherwise registers a new client account (google_sub + verified email, no phone). Never links by email. The driver role is still provisioned out of band.

logout.auth: possession of the refresh token; no Authorization header required (an expired access token must not block sign-out)
logout.idempotent: always 204 — unknown, already-revoked or expired tokens give the same answer

invalid_request.when: id_token / refresh_token missing or not a string

invalid_refresh_token.when: unknown, expired, already used, or revoked; reusing a token consumed more than reuse_grace_seconds ago also revokes every token of that session — sign in again. A concurrent/retried refresh within the window is only rejected (the winner's successor stays valid); no extra token is issued.

error.message: Refresh token is invalid, expired, or already used

rate_limited.when: more than 10 firebase-exchange, google (or 10 logout) calls per minute per client

google_token_invalid.when: signature, issuer, expiry or audience (not in GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS) check failed

error.message: Google has not verified the email of this account
Google sign-in is not configured on this server

auth_method_disabled.when: the method is not in GET /v1/auth/config methods (e.g. native/firebase-exchange while Google-only)

error.message: Sign-in with phone is disabled on this server
